directed.source_grounded_mathematics: The authors propose that the Riemann zeros are eigenvalues or frequencies of an unknown wave system whose underlying classical trajectories are chaotic. directed.conceptual_reading: The analogy functions as a constraint generator rather than evidence that the desired object exists. Its value lies in forcing compatibility among independent descriptions and producing checkable correlation predictions.
directed.representation_or_bridge: A hypothetical self-adjoint spectral system would bridge real eigenvalues, chaotic periodic-orbit mechanics, and the prime-encoded zeta zeros.
directed.boundary_or_failure: No operator or dynamical system is constructed in this unit, so fruitful consequences cannot be promoted to a proof of RH.
